snippet.title: The Tower - A Bomb's Climb
snippet.description:
"The Tower - A Bomb's Climb" is a game available on XBox LIVE indie games by Smudged Cat Games.  It's a game with addictive gameplay and a simple premise, climb as high up the tower as you can without falling into the fire below. As well as a single player challenge mode the game features local and online multiplayer where you need to climb the tower as fast as you can to dunk your friends in the flames below and win the match.

http://marketplace.xbox.com/en-GB/Product/The-Tower-A-Bombs-Climb/66acd000-77fe-1000-9115-d802585504b7

http://www.smudgedcat.com/abombsclimb.html
